question: Our small color-cosmetics brand is launching a lip gloss and a matching mascara, both colored with D&C Red No. 22. Is D&C Red No. 22 permitted in both, and does it need certification?

sources.heading: CVM GFI #223 Small Entity Compliance Guide Declaring Color Additives in Animal Foods
sources.text: ist. A color additive or the lake of a color additive subject to certification must be declared by the name of the color additive listed in the applicable regulation in part 74 (Subpart A – Foods) or part 82 (Subpart B) of the 21 CFR, except that it is not necessary to include the “FD&C” prefix or the term “No.” in the declaration. For example, a certified color additive may be listed by a specific or abbreviated name such as "FD&C Blue No. 1" or "Blue 1." However, the term “Lake” shall be included in the declaration of the lake of the certified color additive (e.g., Blue 1 Lake). You may parenthetically declare an appropriate alternative name of the certified color additive following its common or usual name as specified in part 74 or part 82 of the 21 CFR.
